_comments.buildCommand: Runs 'npm run build' which executes Vite build process
_comments.outputDirectory: Vite outputs compiled files to 'dist' folder - Vercel serves from here
_comments.rewrites_spa: Critical for SPA routing! All requests (except static assets) route to index.html so React Router can handle navigation. Prevents 404 errors on page refresh/direct URL access
_comments.headers_index: Never cache index.html to ensure users get latest app version. Always revalidate from server
_comments.headers_assets: Cache versioned assets (CSS/JS with content hash) for 1 year since Vite creates new hashes on code changes
_comments.cleanUrls: Removes .html extension from URLs for cleaner routing (e.g., /dashboard instead of /dashboard.html)
